title: Chapter 6470: King Of Gods

Chapter 6470: King Of Gods

Chapter 6470: King of Gods

“Boom!” No one remained standing from the violent quakes.

“Defend!” Alch-deer’s tree released a golden flame into the air, wanting to seal the sky.

His followers did the same to help him bolster the barrier. Alas, each slam was stronger than the previous.

“Impossible.” Alch-deer became alarmed since he had a strong understanding of the dream realm, Paramount and Paragon included.

A dream shouldn’t actively attack another. Furthermore, another dreamer in Paragon shouldn’t be able to control the dream to this extent. Only a supreme overlord or an immortal could do so.

“Keep up!” He roared, not holding anything back for the sake of protecting the village.

Unfortunately, the struggle appeared futile.

“Bam!” A corner of the barrier crumbled, sending numerous inhabitants flying.

Alch-deer and stronger cultivators staggered several steps backward.

From the exposed corner in the sky came a flower of foreign energy. With that, Gold Village became connected with Paragon.

Everyone saw numerous stairways; at the top were powerful gods of various appearances. Some wore armor with pulsing flames. Another wielded a heavenly sword capable of cutting down stars. One looked massive enough to break continents.

At the highest spot stood a king of the gods, powerful enough to command his subjects. His armor exuded the power of tribulation. His great hammer was particularly intimidating.

“Skyraiser Ancestor!” Alch-deer recognized him.

“He started a special kingdom in Paragon.” An emperor said.

This eternal ancestor entered Paragon and obtained its power, culminating in him being the supreme ruler. In Paragon, having more gods meant an increase in personal cultivation.

“Does he have full control over Paragon’s power?” Everyone wondered while staring at Alch-deer.

“No, he’s only the king of the gods, not the lord yet.” Alch-deer was the lord of Gold Village and could sense something different.

Skyraiser Ancestor was on the same level as Ocean-gaze and Earthsplitter but somehow possessed far more power. Where was it coming from?

“My love!” Skyraiser saw his wife lying on the ground and immediately raised his hammer.

Lightning beams immediately descended and teleported Earthsplitter back to his kingdom. Rising was also taken back.

Skyraiser then channeled his power to stabilize them before letting others take them away for recovery.

“Who attacked my wife?!” He shouted ferociously as he gazed around, wanting to crush the village.

“Go!” Alch-deer sent his tree’s flames toward the invader who retaliated by sending out flames from his eyes.

Alch-deer had the upper hand this time, his flames triumphing over the opponent’s. They pushed upward to inflict damage against the kingdom.

Skyraiser found this unbelievable - a one-fruit emperor being the lord of Gold Village. Moreover, the guy was stronger than him.
